inputs.text: Full-length figure from head to feet, three-quarter front pose: a rakshasa sorcerer of the underworld, sea-green skin, sharp fangs, a dark jade cloth hood pulled low over his brow with two curved dark horns rising through the hood, dark jade robes with gold patterned borders and a jewelled scale-patterned mantle over the shoulders. His right hand holds up a round bronze hanging oil lamp on a short chain, glowing with one small flame; his left hand is raised with fingers spread, casting a spell. Exactly two arms and two hands, the plain grey backdrop directly behind the head. Hades-style painterly cel-shaded game character art with bold dark ink outlines, hand-painted textures, saturated vivid colours and strong coloured rim lighting, with Indian miniature-painting ornament: fine gold-leaf detail and flat patterned colour fields on the clothing and armour, crisp black contour lines. Three-quarter top-down game sprite view, a single character, the entire figure visible from head to feet, standing on a plain flat light-grey background that fills the rest of the image.
